rows.evidence: The pytest run after the change shows only 2 failures (test_holidays_are_informational and test_week_one_starts_on_first_monday), with 6 passing. test_midweek (W05-3 == 2026-01-28), test_week_one (W01-1 == 2025-12-29) and test_sunday (W53-7 == 2027-01-03) were not among the failures, so they passed. The failure output also directly shows parse_iso_week('2026-W01-1') returning date(2025, 12, 29).
